evidence.SUPPORTED: passed its pre-registered test in both periods after costs on its tier
evidence.WEAK: passed thinly (few events, one tier, near the bar)
evidence.CONFLICTING: helped in one period or tier and hurt in another

permission.PAPER: may be a reason in a paper decision (inside its tier)
permission.CONTEXT: shown and explained, never a reason to trade
permission.LIVE_PROVEN: enough live paper evidence to be considered for real money (none yet)

meaning.unavailable: a runtime flag: its data is missing or stale right now, which always means no trade

rule: Jarvis acts only on PAPER (or LIVE_PROVEN) cards and says the evidence word whenever it uses an idea. A CONTEXT or OFF idea may be described, never given as a reason to buy.
